topics.title: Write a paragraph about your ideal school.
guiding_questions: How would you like your ideal school to be?
Is your current school ideal? Why?
What subjects do you prefer to study?
How do you like to study them?
Do you use the Internet while you are studying? Why?
topics.sample_essay: My ideal school is modern and comfortable. It has smart boards and computers. Teachers are kind and helpful. I prefer to study English and Science. I like to study them with experiments and videos. I use the Internet for research. My current school is good but not perfect. I hope all schools become ideal one day.
